name: OT Cybersecurity Governance
description: Industrial cybersecurity governance responsibilities shall be defined, monitored, and aligned with operational safety and business continuity objectives.

name: Control System Network Segmentation
description: Operational technology networks shall be segmented from enterprise environments, with controlled conduits between zones and monitored trust boundaries.

name: Privileged and Remote Access
description: Privileged access to control systems shall be tightly controlled, logged, approved, and secured through strong authentication and session oversight.

name: Change Management for OT Assets
description: Changes to field devices, controllers, historians, and engineering workstations shall be assessed, approved, tested, and documented before deployment.

name: Threat Monitoring and Logging
description: Security-relevant events from industrial assets shall be collected, monitored, and correlated to identify malicious activity or unsafe conditions.

name: Incident Response for Industrial Environments
description: The organization shall maintain OT-specific incident response playbooks covering containment, escalation, forensic preservation, and operational recovery.

name: Backup and Restoration of OT Systems
description: Critical control system configurations, logic, and supporting services shall be backed up and restoration procedures tested regularly.

name: Supplier and Integrator Security
description: Vendors, integrators, and maintenance providers shall be assessed, contractually controlled, and supervised when accessing OT environments.

name: Physical Security for Control Assets
description: Control cabinets, network closets, and engineering workstations shall be physically protected against unauthorized access and tampering.

name: Asset Inventory and Vulnerability Management
description: Industrial assets shall be inventoried, monitored for vulnerabilities, and maintained under a risk-based remediation program.
